descricao: An odd function within this level is its memory-altering abilities, making people imagine the entire level like a dream. How this occurs is when one interacts with a Memory Lurker. Memory Lurkers are small, squid-like entities that fly around the skybox frequently, often lurking around islands. When a wanderer interacts with a Memory Lurker, the entity will grab the wanderer's head and take full control of the brain. Then, it will turn the wanderer's surroundings into what the Memory Lurker wants them to be, which usually varies.
